articles.title: Mord an Brian Thompson: Richterin schließt Todesstrafe für Luigi M. aus
articles.teaser: Ein Jahr nach dem Attentat auf den Chef eines US-Krankenversicherers wurde die Todesstrafe für den Angeklagten ausgeschlossen. Eine lebenslange Haft sei aber möglich.
articles.image_title: Mord an Brian Thompson: NEW YORK, NEW YORK - DECEMBER 19: Luigi Mangione, suspect in the killing of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson in New York City, arrives at a heliport with members of the NYPD on December 19, 2024 in New York City. The 26-year-old was arrested in Pennsylvania on December 9 after being spotted at a McDonald's in Altoona amid a national manhunt. Mangione also appeared in a Pennsylvania court on forgery and firearms charges today, where he waived extradition to New York after being indicted on 11 charges including first-degree murder in furtherance of terrorism. (Photo by Stephanie Keith/Getty Images)

articles.title: Raumfahrt: Nasa verschiebt bemannten Mondflug wegen Kälte in Florida
articles.teaser: Die Nasa hatte für den 6. Februar den ersten bemannten Mondflug seit 50 Jahren geplant. Weil die Temperatur in Florida dann um den Gefrierpunkt liegt, wird daraus nichts.
articles.image_title: Raumfahrt: CAPE CANAVERAL, FLORIDA - JANUARY 17: NASA's Artemis II is rolled from the Vehicle Assembly Building at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center on January 17, 2026 in Cape Canaveral, Florida. NASA’s integrated SLS (Space Launch System) rocket and Orion spacecraft for the Artemis II mission are being rolled to Launch Pad 39B ahead of the 10-day mission in February 2026, which will take the crew around the Moon and back to Earth. (Photo by Joe Raedle/Getty Images)

articles.title: USA: Mindestens 50 Tote durch extreme Kälte in den USA

articles.image_title: USA: A worker clears snow along the Brooklyn Heights Promenade in New York City on January 26, 2026. A monster storm barreling across the United States had killed at least 11 people on Monday, prompting warnings to stay off the roads, mass flight cancelations and power outages after a weekend of misery. The storm dumped snow, sleet and freezing rain across swathes of the country from Texas to New England, with temperatures set to fall dangerously low this week. (Photo by ANGELA WEISS / AFP via Getty Images)
